headline: No API changes break the bot today and research was thin, so there are two ideas: log the trades you skip so not trading counts as a win, and warn when your morning picks are really one bet on BTC.

ideas.title: /skip: log the trades you didn't take
ideas.why: One tap logs a trade you nearly took but skipped, with the reason (no stop, chasing, after a loss). The 21:00 reminder and /week count skips next to trades, and the evening scorecard shows how the skipped coin moved. Not trading becomes something you can see and score.

ideas.title: "Same bet" warning on the morning list
ideas.why: Many alts move with BTC, so three longs on three alts can act like one big long. The scanner measures each pick's 1h correlation with BTC and, when most picks point the same way and move with BTC, says so at the top: treat them as one trade and size the total, not each.

sources.title: A Checklist Won't Make You a Great Trader. It'll Just Stop You From Being Your Own Worst Enemy | HackerNoon
